findings.finding: Gain predicate accepts equality for all nine strong-reference metric deltas. With changed publications and all strong-reference deltas zero, this reports SOURCE_DEPENDENT_GAIN without measured positive gain.
findings.repair: Require at least one strictly positive strong-reference IDF1/HOTA/AssA delta before selecting a gain status. Keep all-zero strong-reference case distinct from weak-reference-only change; do not change prediction or scoring.

findings.finding: No selected removable legal edge is reported NO_ACTUAL_CONFLICT_NO_COUNTERFACTUAL, although redundant conflicts on originally rejected edges could exist.
findings.repair: Use NO_ACTUAL_REMOVABLE_LEGAL_CONFLICT_NO_COUNTERFACTUAL or equivalent precise wording. Raw, redundant and actual deletions are already separated.

findings.finding: Remote mode verifies stored manifest pins against fetched origin/main blobs and adds receipt pins; final mode also checks remote verification receipt. A local artifact changed after manifest creation is not itself reread before remote verification.
findings.repair: At index, remote and final verification, check actual local bytes against every existing manifest pin and ensure PUBLIC_ARTIFACT_MANIFEST stays unchanged across the science and receipt commits. This is delivery validation only; preserve frozen sources/results/seals.
